titleZh: 科乐收（Claas）发布新一代拖拉机系列：聚焦效率、自动化与操作舒适性
summaryZh: 科乐收（Claas）在2026年美国农场进步展（Farm Progress Show）上发布了三个全新拖拉机系列——Arion 6、Axion 8和Axion 9，功率覆盖165至450马力。新产品围绕高效性能、操作舒适性、辅助与自动化以及可靠性与正常运行时间四大核心主题进行开发。全系搭载无级变速Cmatic变速箱、新一代智能动力总成管理系统（含Auto Load Anticipation预测性驱动控制）、CEBIS connect操作系统，并全面集成Claas connect数字平台，支持精准农业功能与自动化作业。
featuredReason: 科乐收新一代拖拉机全面集成自动化、智能动力总成管理和数字农业平台，代表了大型农业装备向智能化、精准化演进的最新方向，对智慧畜牧行业中的饲草种植与大田管理环节具有重要参考价值。

Claas launches new generation of tractors

Farm Progress Show: Efficiency, automation, operator comfort and reliability are hallmarks of the new Arion and Axion 8 and 9 tractors from Claas.

Gil Gullickson,Editor,Wallaces FarmerSeptember 2, 2026

Subscribe to Farm Progress AGTech — our free, twice-weekly newsletter delivering the latest innovations, emerging technologies and expert insights to your inbox.

Claas launched three tractor lines at this week’s Farm Progress Show: the Arion, the Axion 8 and Axion 9 models that span 165 to 450 hp.

“When we developed this new generation [of tractors], we focused on four main topics: efficient performance, operator comfort, assistance and automation, and uptime and reliability,” said Tanner Whipps, product and sales specialist for Claas of America.

Specifics

The Arion 6 Cmatic lineup replaces the Arion 600 Series with two new models that deliver 165 and 205 hp, respectively. These tractors are designed for livestock operations, hay and forage production, mixed farming and transport. Company officials said these compact six-cylinder tractors combine maneuverability with premium comfort and intelligent drivetrain management.

Related:Favorite products from FPS26

Additional Arion 6 Cmatic features include:

Claas-built Cmatic continuously variable transmission

wheel loader operating mode

Proactiv front-axle suspension

premium infotainment with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto

dynamic steering for loader applications

The Axion 8 Cmatic lineup replaces the previous Axion 800 lineup with three models ranging in horsepower from 240 to 313. It’s designed for planting, tillage, grain cart and forage applications. Features include:

new Cemos auto powertrain management

dynamic power engine management

Auto Load Anticipation predictive drivetrain control

Cmatic continuously variable transmission

54-gallon-per-minute load-sensing hydraulics

rear-lift capacity exceeding 22,000 pounds

standard front hitch

The Axion 9 Cmatic Series has seven models with a 330- to 450-hp range for heavy tillage, seeding and transport applications. It contains both wheeled and Terra Trac configurations.

Claas launched three new tractor lines at the Farm Progress Show, including this Claas Axion 8.290 tractor. (Photos by Gil Gullickson)

Cab comfort

“We completely redesigned the cab to be super comfortable, super quiet,” Whipps said.

Claas officials said the cab design improves visibility, reduces fatigue and enhances productivity. The cab also offers improved ergonomics, additional storage and outstanding visibility in every direction, they added.

Available comfort features include:

heated, ventilated and massage seats

four-point cab suspension

up to 22 LED work lights generating as much as 56,000 lumens

optional second 12-inch touchscreen display

high-resolution camera integration

dynamic steering for easier headland turns and loader work

Operators also benefit from the latest CEBIS connect operating system, which combines tractor controls, implement management and precision farming functions into an intuitive touchscreen interface.

Related:2027 Farm Progress Show returns to Decatur, Ill.

Cab comfort for the operator was a focus for Claas when it designed its new Arion and Axion tractor lines. The cab features low noise levels, improved ergonomics, additional storage and high visibility.

Smarter powertrain management

Across all Axion Series tractors, Claas has paired FPT six-cylinder engines with its continuously variable Cmatic transmission and a new generation of intelligent drivetrain management. Company officials said the system continuously coordinates engine speed, transmission operation and implement load to maximize fuel efficiency while maintaining consistent field performance.

Key technologies include:

Auto Load Anticipation. It continuously learns implement loads to anticipate and adapt the machine to increase productivity and efficiency.

Auto Droop. Tech automatically optimizes engine speed under changing conditions.

Intelligent power management. This delivers additional horsepower only when required.

Better transitions. Transitions are seamless between field and transport operations.

Improved safety. An automatic trailer overrun braking option improves transport safety.

Connected farming

Each new tractor is fully integrated with the Claas connect digital platform, giving producers real-time access to machine information from the office, mobile device or dealership.

The platform allows users to:

Related:Farm Progress Show weathers storms, showcases ag innovation

plan and transfer work orders

monitor machine location and performance

view maintenance status

document field operations automatically

share guidance lines between compatible machines

enable remote display viewing for dealer service support

Integrated GPS guidance, ISOBUS compatibility and automated implement management further simplify operation while improving field accuracy and productivity.

Automation

The new tractor family introduces an expanded suite of automation features that reduce repetitive tasks and improve consistency in the field, Claas officials said. Features such as automatic headland management, guidance-line selection and intelligent implement control allow operators to focus on overall job performance instead of routine machine functions.

About the Author

Gil Gullickson

Editor, Wallaces Farmer

Gil Gullickson grew up on a farm that he now owns near Langford, S.D., and graduated with an agronomy degree from South Dakota State University. Earlier in his career, he spent 13 years as a Farm Progress editor, covering Minnesota and the Dakotas.

Gullickson is a widely respected and decorated ag journalist, earning the Agricultural Communicators Network writing award for Writer of the Year three times, and winning Story of the Year four times. He is a past winner of the International Federation of Agricultural Journalists’ Food and Agriculture Organization Award for Food Security. He has served as president of both ACN and the North American Agricultural Journalists.

translationZh:
科乐收（Claas）在本周的农场进步展（Farm Progress Show）上发布了三个拖拉机系列：Arion、Axion 8和Axion 9，功率覆盖165至450马力。

“在开发这一代新拖拉机时，我们聚焦于四大核心主题：高效性能、操作舒适性、辅助与自动化，以及正常运行时间和可靠性。”科乐收美国公司产品与销售专家Tanner Whipps表示。

**具体细节**

Arion 6 Cmatic系列取代了此前的Arion 600系列，推出两款新机型，功率分别为165马力和205马力。该系列拖拉机专为畜牧养殖、干草与饲草生产、混合农业和运输作业而设计。公司官员表示，这款紧凑型六缸拖拉机兼具灵活操控性、卓越舒适性和智能传动系统管理。

Arion 6 Cmatic系列的其他特点包括：

科乐收自产Cmatic无级变速传动系统

装载机操作模式

Proactiv前桥悬挂

支持Apple CarPlay和Android Auto的高级信息娱乐系统

适用于装载机作业的动态转向系统

Axion 8 Cmatic系列取代了此前的Axion 800系列，推出三款机型，马力范围240至313马力。该系列专为播种、整地、运粮车和饲草作业而设计。特点包括：

全新的Cemos自动动力总成管理系统

动态功率发动机管理

Auto Load Anticipation预测性驱动控制

Cmatic无级变速传动系统

每分钟54加仑的负载敏感液压系统

后提升能力超过22,000磅

标配前悬挂

Axion 9 Cmatic系列共七款机型，马力范围330至450马力，适用于重型整地、播种和运输作业。该系列提供轮式和Terra Trac履带式两种配置。

**驾驶室舒适性**

“我们完全重新设计了驾驶室，使其超级舒适、超级安静。”Whipps表示。

科乐收官员表示，驾驶室设计改善了视野、减少了疲劳并提升了生产力。他们补充说，驾驶室还提供了改进的人体工程学设计、更多储物空间以及全方位卓越视野。

可选的舒适性配置包括：

加热、通风和按摩座椅

四点式驾驶室悬挂

多达22个LED工作灯，亮度高达56,000流明

可选第二个12英寸触摸显示屏

高清摄像头集成

动态转向系统，便于地头转弯和装载机作业

操作人员还可受益于最新的CEBIS connect操作系统，该系统将拖拉机控制、农具管理和精准农业功能整合到一个直观的触摸屏界面中。

**更智能的动力总成管理**

在所有Axion系列拖拉机上，科乐收将FPT六缸发动机与其无级变速Cmatic变速箱以及新一代智能传动系统管理相结合。公司官员表示，该系统持续协调发动机转速、变速箱运行和农具负载，以最大化燃油效率，同时保持田间作业性能的一致性。

关键技术包括：

Auto Load Anticipation（自动负载预判）：持续学习农具负载，预判并调整机器以提升生产力和效率。

Auto Droop（自动降速）：在变化条件下自动优化发动机转速。

智能功率管理：仅在需要时提供额外马力。

更优的切换：田间作业与运输作业之间无缝切换。

更高的安全性：可选自动挂车超限制动功能提升运输安全性。

**互联农业**

每台新拖拉机都完全集成到Claas connect数字平台中，使生产者能够从办公室、移动设备或经销商处实时访问机器信息。

该平台允许用户：

规划和传输作业订单

监控机器位置和性能

查看维护状态

自动记录田间作业

在兼容机器之间共享导航线

启用远程显示查看以支持经销商服务

集成GPS导航、ISOBUS兼容性和自动化农具管理进一步简化了操作，同时提高了田间精度和生产力。

**自动化**

科乐收官员表示，新拖拉机家族引入了一套扩展的自动化功能，可减少重复性任务并提高田间作业的一致性。自动地头管理、导航线选择和智能农具控制等功能使操作人员能够专注于整体作业表现，而非常规机器操作。
